name: Mam ca com
summary: Anchovy sauce salted from fish off Cửa Đại and Cù Lao Chàm, hot, and not too salty or too sweet. Spoon it on hot rice, or dip boiled hyacinth beans and garden greens.
origin: Hoi An, the best-known sauce in Chợ Hội An. The market also sells mắm cá nục, mắm thính cá chuồn, cá trích, mắm dưa, and mắm cà pháo.
taste: Hot, and not too salty or too sweet.
howToEat: Spoon it onto a bowl of hot rice and mix.
Or boil hyacinth beans, or garden greens, and dip.
Some cooks roll it in rice paper with slices of grilled veal, herbs, and a green chili, though that plate usually wants mắm nêm.
seoTitle: Mam ca com — anchovy sauce at Hoi An market
seoDescription: Mắm cá cơm at Chợ Hội An is anchovy sauce from Cửa Đại and Cù Lao Chàm. Spoon it on hot rice.
